title: Understanding — Offer — payload
description: A joining party asks a host to begin an engagement; the host answers with a resolvable, versioned reference to the terms that would govern it. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

purpose.description: A short, host-defined category naming the kind of engagement sought (e.g. "membership", "conversation", "transaction"). Opaque to the framework — the host's accepted values are stated out of band.

proposedIdentifier.description: A DID the joining party is willing to be reached at if the engagement proceeds, distinct from `issuer`. OPTIONAL — absent means the joining party proposes continuing under `issuer` itself. It does not take over the thread: the host's response is addressed to `issuer`, and understanding/exchange accepts only `issuer` against this offer (understanding/exchange:issuerMismatch), because control of this identifier is not proven here. It governs only the identity recorded at understanding/seal.

Response.title: Understanding — Offer — response payload
Response.description: The host's terms reference. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

termsRef.description: A resolvable, version-identified, hash-pinned pointer to the terms that would govern the engagement. Where the host's DID document carries a `GovernanceFramework` service (VTI-KEY-052), this MUST name the same document (see spec.md Response).
